name: PasopeIII
source:
It's already been one month since the robot made by the Ochident Factory came to our home. 'I stood at the crossroads of my life and wouldn't touch the thing until I was used to it.

Even if I tried to think of the robot as a boy, as my younger brother... it's hard to think of a robot as anything other than just that -- a robot...

Big brother...what should I do...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ039152.html]DLsite English[/url]]
